entries.lesson: '…anyway / that's just how it is' with a habitual event (note 本來就會)
entries.english: Don't blame yourself — old phones slow down over time anyway. It's not because you installed that app.
entries.context: Comforting a friend who thinks an app ruined their phone
referenceAnswers: 你別自責啦，舊手機本來就會愈用愈慢，不是你裝那個 app 害的。
不用怪自己啦，手機用久了本來就會變慢，跟你裝那個 app 沒關係。

firstAttempt.answer: 不要怪自己，舊手機本來就會變得很慢，跟你安裝的app沒有關係

entries.lesson: put the burden of proof on the other side, with a 'not me' contrast
entries.targetExpression: 舉證責任在…（身上）／要…的是…，不是…
entries.english: You're the one claiming our service is slower than theirs, so you should be the one bringing the data, not asking me to disprove it.
entries.context: In a team meeting, pushing back on a colleague's claim
referenceAnswers: 這個說法是你提出來的啊，舉證責任在你身上，不在我，要拿出數據的是你，不是叫我去證明沒有。
欸，說我們服務比他們慢的人是你耶，所以要拿數據出來的是你，不是我。

firstAttempt.answer: 說我們服務比他們慢的人是你，所以要拿出證據的是你，不應該要我推翻它

entries.lesson: state the feeling first, then the reason; 'didn't even…' with verb copying
entries.english: I'm not upset with you. I'm just a bit disappointed — you didn't even tell me you were changing the plan.
entries.context: To a coworker who rewrote your part of the proposal
referenceAnswers: 我不是在生你的氣，只是有點失望，你連講都沒跟我講一聲就把計畫改掉了。
我沒有生氣啦，只是心裡有點不舒服，你要改計畫連問都沒問我一下。

firstAttempt.answer: 我不是對你不爽，我只是有點失望，你連說都沒跟我說要改計劃

entries.lesson: attach 'obviously/all along' to the given premise that explains the result
entries.english: Of course nobody replied — it's a long weekend, there's hardly anyone in the office.
entries.context: To a teammate who's annoyed that his email got no response
referenceAnswers: 連假本來就沒什麼人在辦公室啊，當然沒人回你
你別急啦，連假期間本來就沒人在上班，當然不會有人回信啊

firstAttempt.answer: 有人回覆才怪，剛有連假，幾乎沒人在上班

entries.lesson: 'didn't even do X' with the object right after 連, plus a 的是你 cleft to pin responsibility
entries.english: You're the one who wants to raise the price, so you should show the numbers — you haven't even asked one customer.
entries.context: Pushing back on a colleague in a product meeting, friendly but firm
referenceAnswers: 想漲價的是你耶，那要拿出數據的應該也是你吧。你連一個客戶都還沒問欸
要調價格的是你啊，所以要說服大家的當然是你。你連一個用戶都沒訪談過欸，先去問再說啦

firstAttempt.answer: 想要把價錢調高是你，所以要拿出數據的人也應該是你吧，你連一個客戶都沒問
